sn44.6:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sārīputto āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhito bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
sn44.6:1.2: atha kho āyasmā sārīputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahākoṭṭhito tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahākoṭṭhitena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn44.6:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sārīputto āyasmantaṃ mahākoṭṭhitaṃ etadavoca
sn44.6:1.4: kiṃ nu kho āvuso mahākoṭṭhita hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti …pe…
sn44.6:1.5: kiṃ panāvuso neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti. iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.6:1.7: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vadesi.
sn44.6:1.8: ko nu kho āvuso hetu ko paccayo yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
sn44.6:2.1: rūpārāmassa kho āvuso rūparatassa rūpasamuditassa rūpanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.6:2.2: na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.6:2.3: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.6:2.4: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.6:2.5: vedanārāmassa kho āvuso vedanāratassa vedanāsamuditassa vedanānirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa hoti …pe…
sn44.6:2.8: viññāṇārāmassa kho āvuso viññāṇaratassa viññāṇasamuditassa viññāṇanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa hoti …pe…
sn44.6:2.9: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa hoti.
sn44.6:3.1: na rūpārāmassa kho āvuso na rūparatassa na rūpasamuditassa rūpanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa na hoti …pe…
sn44.6:3.2: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa na hoti.
sn44.6:3.6: na viññāṇārāmassa kho āvuso na viññāṇaratassa na viññāṇasamuditassa viññāṇanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa na hoti. na hoti tathāgato …pe…
sn44.6:3.7: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa na hoti.
sn44.6:3.8: ayampi kho āvuso hetu ayaṃ paccayo yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
sn44.6:4.1: siyā panāvuso aññopi pariyāyo yena pariyāyenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
sn44.6:4.3: bhavārāmassa kho āvuso bhavaratassa bhavasammuditassa bhavanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa hoti …pe…

sn44.6:4.6: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa na hoti.
sn44.6:4.7: ayampi kho āvuso pariyāyo yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatāti.

sn44.6:5.3: upādānārāmassa kho āvuso upādānaratassa upādānasamuditassa upādānanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa hoti …pe…

sn44.6:6.3: taṇhārāmassa kho āvuso taṇhāratassa taṇhāsamuditassa taṇhānirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipissa hoti …pe…

sn44.6:7.2: etthadāni āvuso sārīputta ito uttariṃ kiṃ icchasi
sn44.6:7.3: taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttassa āvuso sārīputta bhikkhuno vattaṃ natthi paññāpanāyāti.
